units.source_text: 有一天傍晚，久雨初晴，天清人静。

en.t: One evening, after many days of rain had just cleared, the sky was bright and everything was still.

units.source_text: 庭前几株小枫和檞树青青照眼，欣欣向荣。

en.t: Several young maples and oak trees before the garden shone fresh green to the eye, full of thriving life.

units.source_text: 源氏自然而然地感到心旷神怡。

en.t: Genji naturally felt his heart open and his spirits grow refreshed.

units.source_text: 仰望天空，闲吟白居易“四月天气和且清”之诗。

en.t: Looking up at the sky, he idly recited Bai Juyi's verse, "In the fourth month the weather is gentle and clear."

units.source_text: 此时他心中首先隐约地浮现出玉鬘的芳容来，便照例悄悄地来到她的屋子里。

en.t: At that moment, the lovely face of Tamakazura was the first thing to rise faintly in his mind, and as usual he quietly went to her rooms.

units.source_text: 玉鬘正在无拘无束地看书习字，忽见源氏进来，便肃然起立，

en.t: Tamakazura was reading and practicing calligraphy at ease, but when she suddenly saw Genji enter, she stood up respectfully,

units.source_text: 红晕满颊，娇艳之色，十分可爱。

en.t: her cheeks flushed all over, her charming beauty making her wonderfully lovely.

units.source_text: 她那温柔之相，使源氏蓦地回想起当年的夕颜来。

en.t: Her gentle expression suddenly made Genji remember Yugao from long ago.

units.source_text: 便情不自禁，对她言道：“我初见你时，并不觉得你肖似你母亲，

en.t: Unable to restrain his feelings, he said to her, "When I first saw you, I did not think you resembled your mother,

units.source_text: 近来却常常觉得异常肖似，简直分毫不差。

en.t: but lately I often feel that you resemble her extraordinarily, almost without the slightest difference.
My heart is overcome with emotion.

units.source_text: 常见夕雾中将，全无他母亲的面影，觉得他们母子是不肖似的。

en.t: I often see Lieutenant General Yugiri, yet he has none of his mother's look, and I feel that mother and son do not resemble each other.

units.source_text: 想不到世间原有像你这般酷肖母亲的人。”说着流下泪来。

en.t: I never imagined there could be someone in the world who looked so exactly like her mother as you do." As he spoke, tears began to fall.

units.source_text: 他看见一只盒子盖里盛着果子，其中有桔子，便抚弄着桔子，即兴吟诗：

en.t: He saw fruit arranged on the lid of a box, with mandarin oranges among them, and as he toyed with one of the oranges, he composed a poem on the spot:
